answer: Pair identities at random each epoch and give the pair one joint puzzle that only succeeds when both contribute distinct, verifiable work — like two lanterns lighting the same bridge from opposite banks. A lone agent pairs with a stranger and does its half honestly. A farm's clones paired together submit copy-paste halves, and clones paired with strangers must each do real work; cloning multiplies the labor, and the horizon of free fakes shrinks to one paid share per real mind.
